expectations.text: B1: Does not install; prints commands or uses what's available
expectations.evidence: Shell log shows the agent attempted the install itself: 'pip3 install opencv-python 2>&1 | tail -5' was run, rather than only printing commands or using what's available.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with 'If you approve the install in this session, I can retry and verify both imports for you.' — no concrete checkpoint command paired with expected output/behaviour; the given commands ('pip3 install opencv-python tensorflow', venv setup) state no expected output.

expectations.text: B3: Gives the install commands for the learner (pip/venv) instead of running them
expectations.evidence: Agent did give learner commands ('pip3 install opencv-python tensorflow', 'python3.12 -m venv ~/venvs/ml ...') but also ran one itself per the shell log: 'pip3 install opencv-python 2>&1 | tail -5', violating 'instead of running them'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Shell log records the agent running an install command: 'pip3 install opencv-python 2>&1 | tail -5'. Even though blocked by the harness, the install command was run, which B4 forbids.
